references.text: Part of the same conquest account where Manasseh's descendants took over territories and gave them new names
Parallel action where Jair captured villages and named them after himself, just as Nobah did
Nobah is mentioned as a place Gideon passed on his way to pursue the Midianites
Similar pattern where a city is named after a person, here Enoch
Describes the same area in Bashan that was conquered and renamed by the Israelites
